boardMpn.notes: Must be printed or vendor-documented exact identity

mcu.notes: Vendor architecture references are not sample identity

audioPath.notes: Codec DAC/PWM/I2S amplifier and speaker boundary

powerPath.notes: Battery charge NTC power-path and rail evidence

eventInterface.notes: SDK API or stable frame protocol

timestampObservability.notes: Same-clock event resolved audio-start or external test points

codeTool.notes: Name version offline operation and hash

printProfile.notes: Ink layer dot geometry paper lamination and tolerances

firmwareOwnership.notes: Source build static library or stable board API boundary

rustExecutionRoute.notes: Native no_std OpenVela static library ESP-IDF Rust app or stable C ABI

rustTargetTriple.notes: Exact compiler target and host toolchain

rustToolchain.notes: Version source install method and offline archive hash

halOrOs.notes: Exact HAL RTOS BSP and release revision

cAbiContract.notes: OID storage audio USB logs callbacks ownership and error semantics

ffiConcurrencyContract.notes: Thread ISR callback DMA buffer lifetime and reentrancy rules

providerOwnership.notes: C acquire/release atomic or interrupt-safe critical section; exactly one Rust-owned handle

abiLayoutProbe.notes: Final board C compiler passes platform-v1 sizeof align offsetof and real C/Rust link probe

oidQueueEvidence.notes: ISR publication memory ordering sequence wrap cumulative dropped events and end-of-run stats

audioTimestampClass.notes: request-accepted decoder-first-pcm dma-first-buffer or electrical-output; acoustic timing remains external

storageDurabilityContract.notes: Alignment max transfer atomic unit write acceptance sync durability and torn-write behavior

transportStreamContract.notes: Byte-stream partial reads retained remainder MTU backpressure and zero-side-effect BUSY

nativeRustPeripheralReach.notes: Rust can operate OID storage audio USB and diagnostics through the frozen route

unsafeBoundaryPolicy.notes: Unsafe remains inside the board adapter and has an audit record

supplyEvidence.notes: Same revision available for later volume

headMechanical.notes: Envelope work distance angle and connector

tests.method: Record both kit identities front/back labels tools and firmware before power
tests.acceptance: Both kits match BOARD_MPN PCB_REV HEAD_MPN HEAD_REV FW_VERSION

tests.method: Current-limited power-up and rail/idle/peak capture
tests.acceptance: No unexplained overcurrent reset or rail violation

tests.method: Read 24 unique generated codes with both heads and both print batches
tests.acceptance: Each of four head/print cells >=98 percent and zero wrong codes

tests.method: Blank and ordinary-print negative matrix
tests.acceptance: Zero false triggers in the specified matrix

tests.method: Disable wireless disconnect host and run 100 golden mappings
tests.acceptance: 100/100 local events and audio

tests.method: Rebuild flash log generate codes and print from sealed offline artifacts
tests.acceptance: Repeatable commands nonzero failures and recorded hashes

tests.method: Build flash boot and exercise the supplier C reference on both matching samples
tests.acceptance: OID storage audio USB and logs complete with frozen source configuration and hashes

tests.method: Build the locked Rust artifact then flash and boot it on both matching samples
tests.acceptance: Both samples boot the same binary hash and report matching board head and firmware identities
tests.instrument: Cargo board flash CLI and target logs

tests.method: Exercise OID storage audio USB and diagnostic paths from Rust through the selected native or C ABI route
tests.acceptance: Every required peripheral path passes with bounded errors and recorded traces
tests.instrument: Target logs logic analyzer and audio capture

tests.method: Compile the platform-v1 header with the final board C compiler then link and call it from the locked Rust target
tests.acceptance: All sizeof align and offsetof assertions pass and Rust reads the exact provider info structures
tests.instrument: Final C compiler linker rustc and map file

tests.method: Race two startup callers against acquire then release and reacquire under the selected RTOS or critical-section route
tests.acceptance: Exactly one caller owns the provider second returns BUSY and post-release reacquire succeeds

tests.method: Fill OID and audio ISR queues force overflow wrap sequence and query end-of-run stats
tests.acceptance: Every loss appears as a sequence gap and cumulative dropped count with release/acquire or critical-section evidence
tests.instrument: Target trace logic analyzer and queue counters

tests.method: Correlate request accepted decoder first PCM DMA first buffer electrical output and acoustic start where observable
tests.acceptance: Advertised timestamp class matches the measured stage and request-accepted is excluded from output P95
tests.instrument: Target trace logic analyzer oscilloscope and microphone

tests.method: Cut power before and after storage_sync across staged data and active-head commit boundaries
tests.acceptance: Unsynced writes never masquerade as durable synced content survives and boot selects active or last-good deterministically
tests.instrument: Programmable supply target logs and raw storage dump

tests.method: Replay partial reads MTU boundaries BUSY retry disconnect and resume over the selected physical transport
tests.acceptance: Byte order is exact remainder is retained and non-OK calls have the frozen side-effect behavior
tests.instrument: Host DeviceLink harness and target trace

tests.method: Replay DeviceLink v1 transaction transcripts through the target manifest parser storage adapter and selected physical transport including response loss reconnect and power cut points
tests.acceptance: Node/Rust semantic results stay identical; durable offsets advance only after sync; manifest-first CAS idempotency and zero-side-effect failures hold; raw transport and storage traces are retained
tests.instrument: Host DeviceLink runner target trace storage fault injector and power cut fixture

tests.method: Replay identical OID content power and fault vectors through the C reference and Rust product path
tests.acceptance: Normalized events state transitions audio selection and errors match the frozen differential contract

tests.method: Rebuild the Rust firmware from the sealed toolchain Cargo.lock and source archive without network access
tests.acceptance: Binary or documented reproducible sections match and all dependency hashes verify

tests.method: Capture event resolved first PCM and first acoustic output
tests.acceptance: P50 below 150 ms P95 below 200 ms P99 below 300 ms

tests.method: Obtain written same-revision sample and volume availability
tests.acceptance: Exact identities and lifecycle terms documented
